Title: DOC-001
StandardText: Note completed and signed within 3 business days of encounter
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 3.I; DHA OPPE Template Sec III.F

Title: DOC-002
StandardText: Record entry is timely, clear, legible, and complete (including consults)
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 Interpersonal & Communication Skills A

Title: DOC-003
StandardText: Documentation supports the billed/coded level of care and is pertinent to the encounter
SourceCitation: DHA OPPE Template Sec IV.F (record pertinence review)

Title: CC-001
StandardText: Clinical problem solving is effective and appropriate for the presentation
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 Patient Care A

Title: CC-002
StandardText: Care within the applicable standard of care for the presenting condition

Title: CC-003
StandardText: Evidence-based data used in clinical decisions; current/appropriate techniques and treatments
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 Professional Knowledge A and C

Title: MED-001
StandardText: Medication selection dose duration and monitoring appropriate for indication and patient
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 3.E; DHA OPPE Template Sec IV.E

Title: BLD-001
StandardText: Blood/blood component use appropriate (or NA)
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 3.J; DHA OPPE Template Sec IV.D

Title: CON-001
StandardText: Consults/referrals used consistent with the standard of care; specialty involvement timely
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 Patient Care C

Title: COM-001
StandardText: Communicates information effectively to staff, patients, and families; caring and respectful conduct documented
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 ICS B and Patient Care B

Title: SYS-001
StandardText: Cooperates in ongoing process improvement and compliance with national measures
SourceCitation: DHA FPPE Template Sec 4 PBLI A-B

Title: MSR-001
StandardText: Encounter falls within the provider's granted clinical privileges / scope of utilization
SourceCitation: DHA-PM 6025.13 Vol 8 (scope of utilization); local privileging list

Title: MSR-002
StandardText: Supervision requirements met where privileges are supervised (co-signature/preceptor involvement documented)

Title: DBR-001
StandardText: Telemedicine encounter reviewed under distant-site monitoring responsibility (random-sample eligible)

Title: DBR-002
StandardText: Adverse event or patient safety event identified in this encounter reported through the safety/incident channel
SourceCitation: DHA OPPE Template Sec VI.C construct

Title: PC-GMO-001
StandardText: Red-flag screening documented for undifferentiated MSK and headache presentations

Title: PC-GMO-002
StandardText: Return-to-duty/limited-duty determination documented with functional rationale

Title: PC-GMO-003
StandardText: Appropriate escalation/referral threshold applied for presentations beyond GMO scope

Title: EM-001
StandardText: Time-critical diagnoses (ACS/PE/sepsis/torsion) considered and dispositioned appropriately where indicated

Title: EM-002
StandardText: Discharge/disposition includes documented return precautions and follow-up plan

Title: ORTHO-001
StandardText: Neurovascular status documented pre/post intervention for extremity injuries

Title: ORTHO-002
StandardText: Operative/procedural indication documented against conservative-management trial where applicable

Title: MH-001
StandardText: Suicide/violence risk screening and safety planning documented per encounter type

Title: MH-002
StandardText: Medication management includes documented informed consent and monitoring plan where applicable

Title: PT-001
StandardText: Objective functional measures recorded at evaluation and re-assessment intervals

Title: PT-002
StandardText: Plan of care includes measurable goals tied to duty requirements
